title.en: Multiverse-Core: worlds with upper-case letters break on unload, remove, delete and regen
title.zh: Multiverse-Core：名称含大写字母的世界在卸载、移除、删除与重新生成时出错

summary.en: Repair Multiverse-Core so worlds whose names contain upper-case letters can be unloaded, loaded again, removed, deleted and regenerated exactly like lower-case ones.
summary.zh: 修复 Multiverse-Core，使名称含大写字母的世界能像小写世界一样被卸载、重新加载、移除、删除与重新生成。

brief.en: A world such as World2 can be created and found under any casing, but unloading it fails with an internal error that leaves Multiverse reporting it as loaded, and removing, deleting or regenerating it fails or leaves it registered.
brief.zh: World2 这类世界可以创建并以任意大小写查到，但卸载时报内部错误且 Multiverse 仍认为它已加载，移除、删除或重新生成时失败或使其仍被注册。

en: unloadWorld succeeds for a mixed-case world, which is then tracked as unloaded under its original name and every casing
an unloaded mixed-case world can be loaded again from a lookup under any casing
removeWorld (loaded or unloaded), deleteWorld and regenWorld succeed and leave exactly the expected registration, Bukkit world, folder and worlds.yml entry
lookups stay case-insensitive, worlds keep their original name everywhere, lower-case worlds and every upstream unit test keep working
zh: 含大写字母的世界可被 unloadWorld 卸载，并以原名在任意大小写下记录为已卸载
已卸载的含大写字母世界可通过任意大小写查找后重新加载
removeWorld（已加载或未加载）、deleteWorld 与 regenWorld 成功，并留下预期的注册、Bukkit 世界、目录与 worlds.yml 条目
查找保持大小写不敏感、世界在各处保留原名、小写世界与全部上游单测保持正常

WorldManager
world.options

title.en: Chatty: one bad notification channel stops the whole plugin from enabling
title.zh: Chatty：一个错误的通知频道导致整个插件无法启用

summary.en: Repair Chatty so a notifications.yml with an unusable channel no longer stops the plugin from enabling or reloading: every offending channel is skipped and named, everything else keeps working.
summary.zh: 修复 Chatty，使含不可用频道的 notifications.yml 不再阻止插件启用或重载：每个出错的频道被跳过并点名，其余功能照常工作。

brief.en: An action bar channel whose stay exceeds its period makes Chatty fail to enable, and /chatty reload fails with a ProvisionException that names neither file nor channel, after which chat, join handling and notifications stop until a restart.
brief.zh: stay 大于 period 的动作栏频道会让 Chatty 无法启用，/chatty reload 以不点名文件和频道的 ProvisionException 失败，此后聊天、加入处理与通知都停止直到重启。

en: /chatty reload and start-up succeed when notifications.yml contains action bar channels whose stay exceeds their period
every offending channel is skipped and reported by id in a WARNING-or-higher console record
every other channel, including those after an offending one and those of other sections, is registered as before
after such a reload chat and join listeners stay registered, the chat registry is intact and notifications keep advancing; valid files, defaults, /chatty and every upstream unit test keep working
zh: notifications.yml 含 stay 大于 period 的动作栏频道时，/chatty reload 与启动均成功
每个出错的频道被跳过，并在 WARNING 及以上级别的控制台记录中以 id 报告
其余频道（包括出错频道之后的频道和其他分区的频道）照常注册
此类重载后聊天与加入监听器仍注册、聊天注册表完整、通知继续计时；有效文件、默认配置、/chatty 与全部上游单测保持正常
ChattyApi
NotificationTicker
Notification
HandlerList

title.en: BetterTeams: /team help crashes on page 0, prints phantom pages, and plugin lines start with null
title.zh: BetterTeams：/team help 第 0 页崩溃、显示不存在的页码，插件消息以 null 开头

summary.en: Repair BetterTeams so out-of-range help pages clamp to a real page and every prefixed plugin line, from help entries to chest-claim broadcasts, carries the configured prefix instead of null.
summary.zh: 修复 BetterTeams，使越界的帮助页码回落到真实页面，并让每条带前缀的插件消息（从帮助条目到箱子领地广播）使用配置的前缀而非 null。

brief.en: /team help 0 ends in an internal error, /team help 99 prints a footer such as Page 7/6 with no commands, and help entries and the /teama chest disableclaims|enableclaims broadcasts start with the text null.
brief.zh: /team help 0 以内部错误结束，/team help 99 显示 Page 7/6 之类的页脚且没有命令，帮助条目与 /teama chest disableclaims|enableclaims 广播以 null 开头。

en: /team help 0 and negative pages show the first page without an internal error
page numbers past the last page show the last page with its commands
help entries and the chest-claim broadcasts start with the configured message prefix instead of null
valid pages, non-numeric pages, per-command help and every upstream unit test keep working
zh: /team help 0 与负数页码显示第一页且不报内部错误
超出末页的页码显示末页及其命令
帮助条目与箱子领地广播以配置的消息前缀开头而非 null
有效页码、非数字页码、单命令帮助与全部上游单测保持正常
/team help
/teama chest disableclaims
/teama chest enableclaims

title.en: PrometheusExporter: every /metrics scrape waits for the main thread because of players_total
title.zh: PrometheusExporter：players_total 让每次 /metrics 抓取都等待主线程

summary.en: Repair minecraft-prometheus-exporter so the players_total metric is collected on the scrape's own thread instead of being dispatched to the server's main thread.
summary.zh: 修复 minecraft-prometheus-exporter，使 players_total 指标在抓取线程上采集，而不是被派发到服务器主线程。

brief.en: The players_total gauge, a playerdata directory listing that reads no world state, is computed on the main thread for every scrape, so the tick pays for it and a scrape stalls whenever the main thread is busy.
brief.zh: players_total 指标只是列出 playerdata 目录、不读取世界状态，却在每次抓取时都在主线程上计算，导致 tick 为其买单、主线程繁忙时抓取卡住。

en: collecting the registered PlayersTotal metric needs no main-thread work, even while the main thread is blocked
with every other metric disabled, a /metrics scrape completes while the main thread is busy
mc_players_total keeps reporting the number of players known to the server
metrics that read world, chunk or entity state stay on the main thread; default families, disable/enable and every upstream unit test keep working
zh: 采集已注册的 PlayersTotal 指标无需主线程工作，即使主线程被阻塞
禁用其他指标后，/metrics 抓取在主线程繁忙时仍能完成
mc_players_total 继续报告服务器已知的玩家数
读取世界、区块或实体状态的指标仍在主线程采集；默认指标族、禁用/启用与全部上游单测保持正常

title.en: Chatty: chatty reload ignores chat commands added, renamed or removed in chats.yml
title.zh: Chatty：chatty reload 忽略 chats.yml 中新增、改名或删除的聊天命令

summary.en: Repair Chatty so /chatty reload registers chat commands added to chats.yml and unregisters the old name of a renamed command and the command of a removed chat, instead of requiring a server restart.
summary.zh: 修复 Chatty，使 /chatty reload 能注册 chats.yml 中新增的聊天命令，并注销改名命令的旧名称和已删除聊天的命令，而无需重启服务器。

brief.en: After editing chats.yml and running /chatty reload, the chat registry follows the file but the server's commands do not: an added chat command stays unknown, a renamed one keeps answering only to its old name and a removed chat keeps its command.
brief.zh: 编辑 chats.yml 并执行 /chatty reload 后，聊天注册表随文件更新而服务器命令不变：新增的聊天命令仍未知，改名的命令只响应旧名称，删除的聊天仍保留其命令。

en: after /chatty reload a chat command added to chats.yml, aliases included, is registered in the server command map, owned by Chatty, and executes as a chat command
after /chatty reload the previous name of a renamed chat command is no longer registered
after /chatty reload the command of a chat removed from chats.yml is no longer registered
chat commands declared at start-up keep working across reloads, and the chat registry, /chatty and every upstream unit test keep working
zh: /chatty reload 后，chats.yml 中新增的聊天命令（含别名）已注册到服务器命令表、归属 Chatty 并作为聊天命令执行
/chatty reload 后，改名聊天命令的旧名称不再注册
/chatty reload 后，从 chats.yml 删除的聊天的命令不再注册
启动时声明的聊天命令在重载后保持可用，聊天注册表、/chatty 与全部上游单测保持正常

Chat

title.en: Multiverse-Core: creating, importing or cloning a world does not notice that the world already exists
title.zh: Multiverse-Core：创建、导入或克隆世界时未能识别世界已存在

summary.en: Repair Multiverse-Core so createWorld, importWorld and cloneWorld refuse a request whose name or namespaced key belongs to an existing world, and importWorld adopts a loaded Bukkit world addressed by key.
summary.zh: 修复 Multiverse-Core，使 createWorld、importWorld 与 cloneWorld 在请求的名称或命名空间键属于已有世界时拒绝请求，并使 importWorld 能按键接纳已加载的 Bukkit 世界。

brief.en: Requests that address an existing world through the other of its two identities (the_end for world_the_end, gcb:keyed for the world keyed) are not refused: creates and clones end in exceptions after copying or loading worlds, imports complain about invalid folders, and importing a loaded Bukkit world by key fails.
brief.zh: 通过已有世界的另一个身份（world_the_end 的 the_end、世界 keyed 的 gcb:keyed）发出的请求不会被拒绝：创建与克隆在复制或加载世界后以异常结束，导入抱怨目录无效，按键导入已加载的 Bukkit 世界失败。

en: createWorld, importWorld and cloneWorld fail with WORLD_EXIST_LOADED or WORLD_EXIST_UNLOADED when the requested name or key belongs to an existing world, without creating, copying or loading anything
name-based existence failures keep their meaning and order (loaded before unloaded, before folder checks)
importWorld adopts an already-loaded Bukkit world addressed by key, keeping its key and name
lookups by name and by key string, name-based create/clone/unload/remove and every upstream unit test keep working
zh: 当请求的名称或键属于已有世界时，createWorld/importWorld/cloneWorld 以 WORLD_EXIST_LOADED 或 WORLD_EXIST_UNLOADED 失败，且不创建、复制或加载任何内容
基于名称的存在性失败保持原有含义与顺序（先已加载、后未加载、再目录检查）
importWorld 按键接纳已加载的 Bukkit 世界并保留其键与名称
按名称与按键字符串的查找、基于名称的创建/克隆/卸载/移除以及全部上游单测保持通过

title.en: BetterTeams: /team info turns MiniMessage tags in a team description into click and hover events
title.zh: BetterTeams：/team info 会把队伍描述中的 MiniMessage 标签解析成点击与悬停事件

summary.en: Repair the /team info screen so a team description can no longer inject click, hover, insertion, translatable or other MiniMessage content while colour, decoration and reset formatting keep working.
summary.zh: 修复 /team info 信息页，使队伍描述无法注入点击、悬停、插入、翻译等 MiniMessage 内容，同时保留颜色、装饰与重置格式。

brief.en: The info screen interprets every MiniMessage tag in the player-controlled description, so <click:run_command:...> becomes a real click event for every viewer, <hover>, <insertion> and <lang> take effect too, and the typed tag text disappears.
brief.zh: 信息页会解析玩家可控描述中的所有 MiniMessage 标签，<click:run_command:...> 会变成对所有查看者生效的点击事件，<hover>、<insertion> 与 <lang> 也会生效，输入的标签文本消失。

en: click, hover, insertion, translatable and other non-formatting tags in a description are shown as literal text and produce no event or non-text component
colour, decoration and reset tags and legacy & codes in a description keep their effect
a description without tags is shown exactly as typed
the info screen keeps its prefix, template colours and other fields, and every upstream unit test keeps passing
zh: 描述中的点击、悬停、插入、翻译及其他非格式标签按字面文本显示，不产生事件或非文本组件
描述中的颜色、装饰、重置标签与 & 传统颜色码保持效果
不含标签的描述按原样显示
信息页保留前缀、模板颜色与其他字段，全部上游单测保持通过
/team info
/teama create
/teama description
MiniMessage

title.en: Chatty: every /chatty reload leaks the notification ticker and bStats threads
title.zh: Chatty：每次 /chatty reload 都泄漏通知计时器与 bStats 线程

summary.en: Repair Chatty so /chatty reload releases the resources the previous configuration owned: the replaced notification ticker's executor thread, the previous bStats submitter (also when metrics are switched off) and the Redisson client no longer pile up with every reload, and cancelling a ticker that never started no longer throws.
summary.zh: 修复 Chatty，使 /chatty reload 释放上一份配置持有的资源：被替换的通知计时器执行器线程、上一个 bStats 提交器（包括关闭统计时）和 Redisson 客户端不再随每次重载累积，且取消从未启动的计时器不再抛出异常。

brief.en: Every reload leaves one more idle pool-<n>-thread-1 and, with bStats enabled, one more bStats-Metrics thread alive, the previous bStats thread survives even when send-metrics is switched off, and cancelTicking() on a ticker that never started throws a NullPointerException.
brief.zh: 每次重载都会多留下一个空闲的 pool-<n>-thread-1 线程，启用 bStats 时还会多一个 bStats-Metrics 线程；即使关闭 send-metrics，上一个 bStats 线程仍存活；对从未启动的计时器调用 cancelTicking() 会抛出 NullPointerException。

en: after any number of /chatty reload calls the set of live plugin-owned threads (JDK default pool-<n>-thread-<m> names, bStats-Metrics, and names containing notification, ticker or metrics) does not grow
every ExecutorService held by the NotificationTicker a reload replaces is shut down and that ticker's notifications stop advancing
cancelTicking() returns normally on a ticker that never started ticking

bStats follows send-metrics across reloads (a live thread when on, none after it is switched off), the Redisson client of a replaced proxy service is shut down, reloads still pick up changed files, notifications keep ticking and every upstream unit test keeps passing
zh: 任意次数的 /chatty reload 之后，插件拥有的存活线程集合（JDK 默认的 pool-<n>-thread-<m>、bStats-Metrics，以及名称包含 notification、ticker 或 metrics 的线程）不再增长
被重载替换的 NotificationTicker 持有的每个 ExecutorService 都已关闭，且其通知不再推进
对从未开始计时的计时器调用 cancelTicking() 正常返回
bStats 随 send-metrics 变化（开启时有存活线程，关闭并重载后不再有），被替换的代理服务关闭其 Redisson 客户端，重载仍能读取修改后的文件，通知继续计时，全部上游单测保持通过
NotificationTicker
ScheduledExecutorNotificationTicker
MetricsSender
ProxyServiceImpl
bStats Metrics
ScheduledExecutorService

八个真实服务器用例通过

reload picks up a changed notifications.yml

bStats metrics stay scheduled after a reload

cancelling a ticker that never started does not throw
reloads do not leak ticker or bStats threads
turning metrics off stops the bStats thread on reload

title.en: Chatty: a failed v2 configuration migration leaves an enabled but dead plugin
title.zh: Chatty：v2 配置迁移失败后插件显示已启用却不再工作

summary.en: Repair Chatty so that a legacy v2 configuration whose migration fails no longer leaves an enabled plugin that handles nothing: quarantine the half-migrated files, tell the operator, start with a default configuration that /chatty reload can use, and migrate caps limits into the range v3 accepts.
summary.zh: 修复 Chatty，使 v2 旧配置迁移失败时不再留下一个已启用却什么都不处理的插件：隔离半迁移文件、告知管理员、以可被 /chatty reload 使用的默认配置启动，并把 caps 限制迁移到 v3 接受的范围内。

brief.en: When the migrated configuration of a v2 config.yml cannot be loaded, Chatty only logs 'using defaults': the plugin stays enabled with no listeners and no notifications, the broken files stay in plugins/Chatty so every /chatty reload fails, and out-of-range v2 caps limits are copied unchanged.
brief.zh: v2 config.yml 迁移后的配置无法加载时，Chatty 只记录 'using defaults'：插件仍显示已启用却没有监听器和通知，坏文件留在 plugins/Chatty 中导致每次 /chatty reload 都失败，越界的 v2 caps 限制原样复制。

en: when the migrated configuration cannot be loaded, the half-migrated v3 files are moved to a sibling Chatty_failed_migration_<timestamp> folder and the plugin starts again with a freshly generated default configuration
after such a failure the plugin is fully working: chat and join listeners are registered, the shipped chats are in the registry and /chatty reload succeeds
the failure is reported at WARNING or SEVERE level naming the Chatty_old_<timestamp> backup, the quarantine folder and that the plugin started with a default configuration

caps.length and caps.percent are migrated into the range v3 accepts and listed in the migration notes; the legacy folder keeps its config.yml as written, /chatty, a successful migration and every upstream unit test keep working
zh: 迁移后的配置无法加载时，把半迁移的 v3 文件移到同级的 Chatty_failed_migration_<时间戳> 目录，并以全新生成的默认配置重新启动插件
失败之后插件完全可用：聊天与加入监听器已注册、自带聊天在注册表中、/chatty reload 成功
以 WARNING 或 SEVERE 级别报告失败，点名 Chatty_old_<时间戳> 备份目录、隔离目录，并说明插件以默认配置启动
caps.length 与 caps.percent 迁移到 v3 接受的范围内并列入迁移说明；旧目录保留原样的 config.yml，/chatty、成功的迁移与全部上游单测保持正常

HandlerList

legacy configuration is moved aside before migrating
info command answers from the console
chat pipeline is live after a failed migration
failed migration is quarantined and reported
migrated caps limits are clamped to the v3 range
chatty reload works after a failed migration

title.en: Chatty: a migrated v2 configuration breaks the plugin and loses its language
title.zh: Chatty：迁移后的 v2 配置让插件无法工作并丢失语言设置

summary.en: Repair Chatty so a legacy v2 configuration without a spy section migrates to usable per-chat spy formats, a chats.yml spy block that declares only enable still loads, and the v2 locale and the v2 spellings of a language select the right v3 language.
summary.zh: 修复 Chatty，使缺少 spy 段的 v2 旧配置能迁移出可用的每个聊天的 spy 格式，只写了 enable 的 spy 段也能加载，并让 v2 的 locale 与 v2 拼写的语言选中正确的 v3 语言。

brief.en: A v2 config.yml without a spy section migrates to spy.format: null, so the migrated plugin and every /chatty reload fail with NullPointerException: input; a v2 general.locale is not carried over, and language: ru or zh_CN in settings.yml silently falls back to English.
brief.zh: 缺少 spy 段的 v2 config.yml 会迁移出 spy.format: null，导致迁移后的插件与每次 /chatty reload 都以 NullPointerException: input 失败；v2 的 general.locale 未被迁移，settings.yml 中的 language: ru 或 zh_CN 会无提示地回退为英语。

en: migrating a v2 config.yml without a spy section gives every migrated chat a spy.format built from &6[Spy] &r{format}, and the migrated chats load and reload
a chats.yml spy block that declares only enable loads on /chatty reload with a non-null spy format
the v2 general.locale is migrated to the matching v3 language, settings.yml accepts the v2 spellings of a language, and an unsupported language is reported and falls back to English
explicit spy formats, a v2 spy.format.chat template, supported language tags, /chatty and every upstream unit test keep working
zh: 迁移缺少 spy 段的 v2 config.yml 时，每个聊天都得到由 &6[Spy] &r{format} 生成的 spy.format，迁移后的聊天能加载并重载
chats.yml 中只声明 enable 的 spy 段能通过 /chatty reload 加载，且 spy 格式非 null
v2 的 general.locale 迁移为对应的 v3 语言，settings.yml 接受 v2 拼写的语言，不支持的语言会被报告并回退为英语
显式的 spy 格式、v2 的 spy.format.chat 模板、受支持的语言标签、/chatty 与全部上游单测保持正常
